source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7 ("Unopposed returns: five to be fought")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Contests from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8; unopposed returns from the News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7, and the Irish News of the same date.

note: Triennial election for the 21 seats, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Eleven divisions were contested and ten were filled unopposed. Returned unopposed. Citation restored to the original page: the 5 Nov re-citation pointed to an unrelated page (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
